arms.TREATMENT: outgoing-flow q when available; exact isotropic fallback otherwise; q is measured in this treatment world

conditions.production: retained-material desired-speed resistance + A turn ceiling + D same-flow headway + G pheromone + current movement, recruitment, TrailPlateBirth, stratigraphy

flowDefinition.segment: previous completed 1/60-second tick, from actual post-collision positions, one per existing live ant
flowDefinition.outward: strictly increasing distance from SPAWN_CENTER; midpoint radial dot segment displacement > 0
flowDefinition.q: equal-weight mean of eligible realized segment unit directions
flowDefinition.fallback: exact same isotropic transform as control

conditions.rngAndPlacement: Runtime transform changes only the accepted heading expression; q is measured before calling the existing heading draw; drawNext forwards the original RNG exactly once. Placement source remains byte-locked.

measures.serialDependence: Within-run time samples are descriptive; seeds are the replication units.
measures.lateWindow: Nominal one-second samples from 300 through 600 seconds inclusive; 301 observations per run.
measures.comparison: No outcome threshold was added. Report differences descriptively; visual assets remain for author review.
